metadata.framework: NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 (SI-7, SC-12, SC-13) / NIST FIPS 140-3

findings.remediation: Upgrade OpenSSL to >= 3.0.14 LTS (or 3.2+) and configure/activate a CMVP-validated FIPS 140-3 provider for SC-13 workloads.
findings.area_of_concern: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

findings.description: PyCrypto has been unmaintained since 2013, contains unpatched vulnerabilities, and is not FIPS 140-3 validated.
findings.remediation: Migrate all cryptographic operations to 'cryptography' (pyca/cryptography >= 41.0.0) linked against a CMVP-validated OpenSSL 3 FIPS provider.
findings.area_of_concern: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

findings.remediation: Upgrade org.bouncycastle dependencies to >= 1.77, and replace standard bcprov-* with CMVP-validated bc-fips (>= 1.0.2.4) in approved mode for FIPS 140-3 / SC-13 workloads.
findings.area_of_concern: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries

findings.description: Active development of crypto-js has been discontinued; pure JS crypto lacks constant-time side-channel resistance and has no FIPS 140-3 validation.
findings.remediation: Migrate to Node.js built-in 'node:crypto' (compiled against a FIPS-validated OpenSSL provider) or Web Crypto API (SubtleCrypto).
findings.area_of_concern: AOC-09: Crypto Dependencies on Unsupported Libraries
